conclusion: A no-x86 control-plane executable is a meaningful separation gate, but it is not a loader, GPU execution, or Triton end-to-end result.
decision: Advance only to P3-HOST-NATIVE-03, where the accepted CP13 loader and runtime protocol must be connected and compared against the gem5 oracle before the first Triton vecadd gate.
invalidated_assumptions: An x86-free control binary implies PT_LOAD mapping, AQL construction, or instruction execution.
The project already has a passing Triton end-to-end case.
observation: EV-0038 explicitly reports kernel_executed=false and the accepted self-test emits cpu_fallback=false and vega_x86=false; no Triton case has passed.
question_or_symptom: What remains after the first independent no-VEGA_X86 binary links?
